description: Get structured XBRL financial facts for a company. Without 'concept', returns the top-level facts catalog (concepts the company has reported). With 'concept' (e.g. 'Revenues', 'Assets', 'EarningsPerShareBasic'), returns the time series of values for that concept.

concept.description: Optional XBRL concept name (e.g. 'Revenues', 'Assets', 'NetIncomeLoss'). If omitted, returns the catalog of available concepts.

name: edgar_company_facts
